name: tree
gotchas: MatTree has no default data model — it needs a `TreeControl` (`FlatTreeControl` or `NestedTreeControl`) paired with a matching data source (`MatTreeFlatDataSource`/`MatTreeNestedDataSource`) and template node type (`matTreeNodeDef` for flat, `matNestedTreeNode` for nested); mixing a flat control with nested node templates (or vice versa) fails silently rather than throwing a clear error.

Flat trees require every node to carry an accurate `level`, computed by your own transformer function passed to `MatTreeFlattener` — mutating the source data without recomputing levels breaks indentation and the expand/collapse icon state with no error at all.

Lazily-loaded children (fetched only when a node is first expanded) need their own loading state modeled in your data — `MatTreeFlatDataSource`/`MatTreeNestedDataSource` have no built-in async/loading concept, so toggling a node before its children arrive just renders an empty expanded group until you update the data source yourself.
